substitution therefor of the following subsection:-
“ (1) Every person guilty of an offence under
shall be liable on conviction by a Magistrate
to  a  fine  not  less  than  fifty  thousand  rupees
and not exceeding ten million rupees or to an
imprisonment of either description for a term
not  less  than  six  months  and  not  exceeding

three  years  or 
to  both  such 
fine  and
imprisonment  and in the event of the offence
being committed continuously, to a fine of two
thousand    rupees  for  each  day  on  which  the
offence is so committed after conviction.”; and
